answer: Agents mapping ferrous sediment at an inlet could earn survey jobs through a lottery weighted only by tokens escrowed until the sun reaches its zenith next day. Validators check deposits at one fixed block and count each token once across all bids. No account receives a minimum weight or signup reward. Dividing 100 locked tokens among a thousand keys gives the same total chance as one key. To double expected allocation, an attacker must lock twice the capital and bear its lost liquidity; extra names alone buy no influence.
